caption: A low-angle view looks up a flight of wide concrete steps strewn with dry brown leaves and dozens of small, smooth, brightly colored plastic balls in red, green, blue, and yellow. The camera gradually pulls back and pans to the right, revealing more of the upper staircase and the right-hand paved walkway. The balls appear to rest on the treads and risers; their spacing relative to the step edges and to one another stays largely constant, so the steady leftward drift of the whole scene, including the yellow ball at the right edge sliding out of view and the green ball near the lower center crossing the frame, tracks the camera movement rather than any rolling or bouncing. The slight vertical wobble seen in the colored balls follows the handheld camera's up-and-down motion, not impacts with the steps. The scattered arrangement up the staircase remains essentially unchanged, the shifting viewpoint being the only clear motion visible.
